title: Diagnosis of transport properties in Ferromagnets
abstract: The resistivity model as a function of temperature and ionization energy (doping) is derived with further confinements from spin-disorder scattering in ferromagnetic phase. Magnetization and polaronic effects capture the mechanism of both spin independent and spin-assisted charge transport of ferromagnets, including the newly reported Mn$_x$Ge$_{1-x}$ ferromagnetic semiconductor. The computed $T_{crossover}$ below $T_C$ and carrier density in Ga$_{1-x}$Mn$_x$As system are 8-12 K and 10$^{19}$ cm$^{-3}$, remarkably identical with the experimental values of 10-12 K and 10$^{18}-10^{20}$ cm$^{-3}$ respectively. The calculated charge carriers density for Mn$_x$Ge$_{1-x}$ is 10$^{19}$ cm$^{-3}$, which is also in the same order with the experimental values.
